_doc: PER-TEST failure census for the source phase (all tests except tests/build/**). SHRINK-ONLY. A failing test ABSENT from `entries` is a REGRESSION and reds the gate. Every entry MUST carry a full attribution — subsystem, cause, introducedAt, class — or tests/lint/testRatchet.test.js refuses it. `--update` can only REMOVE entries; adding one is a deliberate, attributed hand edit. See scripts/check-test-ratchet.mjs.

tests/copy/voiceMechanics.test.js :: E-E.test: E-E voiceMechanics JSX extension — src/**/*.jsx component ratchet (shrink-only) per-file JSX debt exactly matches the baseline (grew ⇒ rewrite; fell ⇒ bank the win)
tests/copy/voiceMechanics.test.js :: E-E.cause: THE SHIFT RECORD (VOICE-1b, ODQ 854 - this supersedes the 2026-08-07 text, which named one train and two stale figures). TWO trains landed the machine-generated dossier prose on 2026-08-03, not one. P-1 a277f53d336bee4fb2c1fded7e1e08412e7f5776 shipped the SIX state-prose desk leaves (src/data/dossierStateProse/*.generated.js) carrying 635 of the 779 em dashes the two trains landed - 81.5 percent, and it was NAMED NOWHERE until now; P-3 23d118eb25473f8a64e22253802a986045e596ad shipped the causal corpus (src/data/dossierCausalProse.generated.js) with the remaining 144. introducedAt moved from P-3 to P-1 because P-1 ALONE breached the ceiling: the committed baseline at a277f53d3^ totalled em 469 against a budget of 670, so 201 of headroom met 635 of new debt and the arms were already red before P-3 existed - a bisect started at P-3 would have found the row failing at its own parent. MECHANISM: both trains run through scripts/generate-dossier-state-prose.mjs, which transports authored markdown byte-for-byte and validates nothing; no arm exists between docs/content/*.md and docs/VOICE_AND_TONE.md, whose section 3 bans the em dash in any user-facing string. RE-MEASURED at 6770f878f: string-literal debt 1478 against 670 (the old text said 1369) and JSX debt 21 against 6 (the old text said 18). VOICE-1b then burned the corpus's DARK half - 299 pool-key and 142 title em dashes - taking Tier 2 from 1478 to 1028 with the reader-facing variant text untouched at 338. That burn is a DECLARED ONE-TIME SHIFT in the pool keys stateProseKernel.js drawVariant hashes into the draw, and it was free only because the corpus has zero product callers; it becomes impossible the day the stack is wired. The residual 338 stay with the owner-signed T5-ONE-REGEN constituent. THE CURE IS STRIP, NEVER RE-FREEZE (the standing STRIP-never-raise ruling at ODQ line 266); since VOICE-1b the documented refreeze REFUSES a raise mechanically (tests/helpers/shrinkOnlyBaseline.js).
